question: Could you find out the average percentage of the total lifetime sales (LTV) that occur in the first 7 and 30 days after a customer's initial purchase? Also, include the average total lifetime sales (LTV). Please exclude customers with zero lifetime sales. The 7- and 30-day periods should be based on the exact number of hours-minutes-seconds, not calendar days.
sql:
-- Final query: average percentages and average LTV
WITH customer_first AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           MIN(payment_date) as first_payment_date
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_ltv AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           SUM(amount) as total_ltv
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
payment_with_first AS (
    SELECT p.customer_id,
           p.amount,
           p.payment_date,
           cf.first_payment_date,
           (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM p.payment_date) - EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM cf.first_payment_date)) / 3600.0 as hours_since_first
    FROM payment p
    JOIN customer_first cf ON p.customer_id = cf.customer_id
),
customer_early_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        pwc.customer_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN pwc.hours_since_first <= 168 THEN pwc.amount ELSE 0 END) as sales_7days,
        SUM(CASE WHEN pwc.hours_since_first <= 720 THEN pwc.amount ELSE 0 END) as sales_30days,
        cl.total_ltv
    FROM payment_with_first pwc
    JOIN customer_ltv cl ON pwc.customer_id = cl.customer_id
    GROUP BY pwc.customer_id, cl.total_ltv
    HAVING cl.total_ltv > 0
)
SELECT 
    AVG(100.0 * sales_7days / total_ltv) as avg_pct_7days,
    AVG(100.0 * sales_30days / total_ltv) as avg_pct_30days,
    AVG(total_ltv) as avg_total_ltv
FROM customer_early_sales
